description: A React component for a contextual post options menu (dot menu) in Mattermost, providing actions like reply, forward, pin, delete, etc.

classes.name: DotMenuClass
classes.description: React component providing a contextual menu for post actions such as reply, forward, pin, delete, etc.

methods.name: getMessageToCopy
methods.description: Generates the message string to copy, considering translation and message source.

methods.name: disableCanEditPostByTime
methods.description: Disables editing of a post after a certain time limit if applicable.

methods.name: handleEditDisable
methods.description: Sets state to disable editing of the post.

methods.name: copyText
methods.description: Copies post message text to clipboard.

methods.name: handleDeleteMenuItemActivated
methods.description: Opens modal to delete or burn-on-read the post.

methods.name: handleFlagPostMenuItemClicked
methods.description: Opens modal to flag the post.

methods.name: handleMoveThreadMenuItemActivated
methods.description: Opens modal to move the thread.

methods.name: handleForwardMenuItemActivated
methods.description: Opens modal to forward the post.

methods.name: handleEditMenuItemActivated
methods.description: Sets the post into edit mode.

methods.name: handleMenuKeydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for menu actions.

methods.name: handleShowTranslation
methods.description: Opens modal to show post translation.
